text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At least 3,200 jobs have been created and another 1,400 are expected within the next five years in small to medium enterprises funded by the United States-based African Development Foundation.
- Mounting pressure from creditors and the proliferation of back-yard liquid manufacturers has plunged Tru-Cool (Pvt) Ltd into liquidation, putting some 78 jobs on the line.
- Seven people died on Zimbabwe's roads during the weekend and 12 others were injured, police reported on Sunday.
